title: Dynamical Hubbard approach to correlated materials: The case of transition-metal monoxides
authors: Mario Caserta, Tommaso Chiarotti, Marco Vanzini, and Nicola Marzari
abstract:
Author(s): Mario Caserta, Tommaso Chiarotti, Marco Vanzini, and Nicola Marzari

First-row transition-metal monoxides carry a complex interplay between screening, localization, and hybridization throughout the filling of the 3d shell. The loss of quasiparticle weight and formation of satellite structures is described, incorporating both local and nonlocal spin-resolved excitations of the screened effective interaction, and the changing nature of the crystal environment around the localized charges is captured via the local Green’s function of the correlated subspace.
